title: Writes preserve the origin flag
statement: For every alphabet $\Gamma$, side $s\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, possibly blank folded cell content $w$, and possibly absent symbol $a\in\operatorname{Option}(\Gamma)$, the origin flag of the unpacked result of writing $a$ into $w$ on side $s$ equals the origin flag of the unpacked $w$.
hypotheses_covered: possibly blank folded cell content w
replaced:
For every side $s$, every physical cell content $w$ over the folded alphabet, and
every possibly blank base symbol $a$, the origin flag obtained by unpacking the
result of the side-relative write of $a$ into $w$ equals the origin flag obtained
by unpacking $w$.
